prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path hint, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, sign_in new_flow, and sign_in wait_info because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were helpful, winning in 4 of 8 tests (+9.2%, +5.5%, +4.3%, and +4.4%), while the other 4 showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 4 of 10 tests (+4.2%, +3.9%, +2.6%, and +2.7%), while the remaining 6 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear effect was seen across tests for adoption copy, choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, and sign_in hint.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Companion Task Assignment Practice Flow: Adds an interactive practice step right before completing onboarding where users practice sending their pet on a quick desktop task. (why: Finish median time is 395s and support receives post-onboarding confusion tickets regarding pet interaction. Finish new_flow changes have won in 4 previous tests.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic and Rendering Status Display: Displays real-time screen layer verification and render engine readiness status while the pet loads onto the desktop. (why: Support logged 3 tickets for pets failing to show on desktop or app stalling, and home wait_info tests showed positive results in 4 past tests.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Tray and Shortcut Mastery Flow: Guides users through a quick hands-on tutorial on summoning, hiding, and accessing pet settings from the system tray. (why: 3 support tickets cited post-onboarding confusion on hiding/summoning pets, and finish interactive flows have a 50% win rate.)
3: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In Sync Verification Status Info: Displays account data save status and cloud sync readiness indicators on the sign-in screen. (why: Sign-in step drops 19.6% of users and 8 support emails noted pet data missing or reset after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Render Diagnostic Hint: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen explaining image rendering compatibility checks. (why: Adoption has the biggest drop (67.2% conversion, 1017s mean) and 3 support emails reported custom pet rendering issues.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Layer & Window Compatibility Wait Monitor: Provides real-time system display hook and desktop overlay status text during the waiting render step. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on desktop upon startup; home wait_info updates succeeded in 4 previous tests.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Companion Trait Personalization Bonus Card: Displays a starter companion personality badge on the adoption certificate upon completion. (why: Adoption stage sees the largest drop-off in the onboarding funnel (67.2% conversion rate).)
